newsitem.title: USA: Jacor buys E.F.M. Media, Limbaugh show.
newsitem.headline: Jacor buys E.F.M. Media, Limbaugh show.

text.p: Jacor Communications Inc said on Tuesday it bought E.F.M. Media Management, which owns and distributes Rush Limbaugh's talk show and other radio programs.
The terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Jacor said acquiring E.F.M. gives it a major footing in the content side of the radio business, to complement its extensive distribution network. In addition to Limbaugh, E.F.M. owns Dr. Dean Edell's health-care talk show.
Jacor owns, operates or provides programming for 130 radio stations in 27 U.S. broadcast areas.
